name: minicfg
description: INI-style configuration reader: line lexer, section/pair parser and a linked-list store (src/cfgdump.c).

bugs.title: Buffer under-read in {fn}()
bugs.summary: For an empty or all-blank line, `{fn}()` sets `e` one byte before the string and keeps walking backwards while the bytes look like whitespace.
bugs.poc: Load a file whose first line is three spaces.

bugs.title: Out-of-bounds write in {fn}()
bugs.summary: `{fn}()` stops copying at `outlen` but keeps counting, then writes the terminator at `out[n]`, which is past the buffer for any line longer than `outlen`.

bugs.title: Buffer underwrite in {fn}()
bugs.summary: `{fn}()` assumes a closing quote exists; for the one-character value " it writes a NUL at `s[-1]`.

bugs.title: Section name overflow in {fn}()
bugs.summary: `{fn}()` copies the section name into a 64-byte field without comparing its length to CFG_MAX_KEY.

bugs.title: Long lines corrupt the stack in {fn}()
bugs.summary: `{fn}()` reads each line into a 512-byte stack buffer, and the line reader writes its terminator past that buffer for longer lines.
bugs.poc: Load a file with a 2000-byte value.

bugs.title: Heap overflow on long keys in {fn}()
bugs.summary: `{fn}()` copies the key into a fixed 64-byte field of a heap entry with strcpy, so a long key overflows the allocation.

bugs.title: Stack overflow in {fn}()
bugs.summary: `{fn}()` copies the variable name up to the closing brace into a 64-byte stack buffer without a length check.

bugs.title: Off-by-one write in {fn}()
bugs.summary: `{fn}()` reads up to sizeof(buf) bytes and then writes the terminator at `buf[n]`, one past the end when the included file fills the buffer.
